name: DP_SVC_COORD_PLAN_AUDIT
description: This table contains the audit trail data for the Services to Coordinate workflow.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The unique contact serial number for this contact. This number is unique across all patient encounters in your system. If you use IntraConnect, this is the Unique Contact Identifier (UCI).

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: PAT_ID
columns.description: The unique ID of the patient record for this row. This column is frequently used to link to the PATIENT table.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: CM_CT_OWNER_ID
columns.description: The Community ID (CID) of the instance that owns this contact. This is only populated if you use IntraConnect.

columns.name: AUDIT_USER_ID
columns.description: This column stores the user who edited the coordination plan for this audit event.

columns.name: AUDIT_USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: AUDIT_EVENT_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: This column stores the UTC instant at which the audit event occurred.

columns.name: COORD_PLAN_AUD_ACTION_C_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the action that was taken for this audit event. The possible actions are adding a coordination plan, modifying a coordination plan, or deleting a coordination plan.

columns.name: SVC_COORD_PLAN_IDENT
columns.description: This column stores the unique identifier for the coordination plan that was affected by this change. It can be used to join audit trail events to the coordination plan data in DP_SERVICE_COORD_PLAN.

columns.name: AUDIT_COORD_PLAN_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the audit history of the plan name for each audit event.

columns.name: AUDIT_PLAN_IS_INACTIVE_YN
columns.description: This column stores the audit history of the whether the coordination plan was active or inactive for each event.

columns.name: COORD_PLAN_AUD_DEL_RSN_C_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the reason why a coordination plan was deleted from the patient's chart.

columns.name: SVC_COORD_DEL_CMT
columns.description: This column stores the comment provided by the user when deleting a coordination plan from the patient's chart.

columns.name: AUDIT_PLAN_IS_SENSITIVE_YN
columns.description: This column stores the audit history of whether the coordination plan was sensitive for each audit event.
